featured_projects.title: Smart SaltCare
featured_projects.description: A solar-powered smart mobility and weather-alert solution designed for salt-pan workers.
features: Solar-powered smart mobility and environmental hazard early warning system
Multi-sensor telemetry pipeline monitoring brine salinity, temperature, and heat indices
Awarded First Prize at TNWISE 2026 (TANCAM) with 1 Lakh prize amount for rural innovation
Low-latency weather-alert broadcasts warning workers of rapid coastal microclimate shifts

case_study.problem: Salt pan workers face extreme climatic heat and hazardous brine conditions without automated environmental risk warnings or mobility assistance.
case_study.built: Engineered Smart SaltCare, an autonomous solar-powered IoT platform delivering real-time telemetry, automated weather alerts, and smart mobility support.
decisions: Solar energy harvesting with integrated battery management for continuous field operation
Corrosion-resistant telemetry encasings designed to withstand harsh hypersaline conditions
Edge sensor processing paired with low-power wireless alerts to deliver immediate hazard warnings
case_study.outcome: Awarded First Prize at TNWISE 2026 with a 1 Lakh cash prize, advancing to state incubation programs.

featured_projects.title: Private Cloud File Storage System
featured_projects.description: A self-hosted private cloud solution for secure file storage and management.
features: Self-hosted private cloud storage architecture deployed via Docker on Kali Linux
Intuitive web-based console enabling secure file uploads, downloads, and directory management
Privacy-centric design eliminating reliance on third-party cloud storage platforms and external tracking
Isolated persistent Docker volumes ensuring data durability and localized access control

case_study.problem: Public cloud storage solutions impose recurring subscription costs and expose confidential data to third-party telemetry and vendor lock-in.
case_study.built: Architected a self-hosted private cloud file storage server containerized on Kali Linux with a lightweight web management dashboard.
decisions: Docker containerization for rapid deployment, dependency encapsulation, and system security
Dedicated local volume bindings ensuring strict data sovereignty and local network file sharing
Responsive web interface allowing seamless cross-device management without client software installation
case_study.outcome: Successfully established an air-gapped capable, high-security storage hub with zero ongoing infrastructure costs.

featured_projects.title: CRM Application – Fleet Management System
featured_projects.description: A CRM-based application designed to manage fleet operations and related business workflows.
features: Comprehensive CRM platform for tracking client relationships, service bookings, and contracts
Fleet management module automating driver allocation, route optimization, and vehicle tracking
REST API integrations streamlining data exchange between client accounts and operational dispatch
Reduced manual data entry by 40% and improved fleet turnaround dispatch planning by 30%

case_study.problem: Disjointed manual spreadsheets caused communication delays between client account managers and fleet dispatch teams.
case_study.built: Engineered a unified Django CRM and fleet management portal with relational database modeling and automated route planning endpoints.
decisions: Django framework with PostgreSQL for transactional integrity and role-based access control
Algorithmic route planning integrated via REST APIs to optimize transit duration
Dynamic operator dashboards providing real-time visibility into vehicle availability and task progression
case_study.outcome: Accelerated dispatch coordination, cut operational overhead by 40%, and streamlined end-to-end customer fleet workflows.

featured_projects.title: On-Premises NOC Copilot (NetOracle)
featured_projects.description: An air-gapped Network Operations Center copilot designed to support network monitoring, troubleshooting, and operational insights.
features: Air-gapped Network Operations Center copilot functioning with zero external internet dependencies
Real-time syslog and telemetry stream ingestion for automated anomaly detection
Forensic diagnostic engine generating contextual troubleshooting playbooks for network engineers
Recognized in ISRO Hackathon as lead ML security and network diagnostic architecture

case_study.problem: Enterprise NOC teams in air-gapped high-security facilities cannot utilize cloud-hosted AI tools for triage without risking data exfiltration.
case_study.built: Created NetOracle, a fully on-premises intelligent NOC copilot correlating telemetry logs and synthesizing operational troubleshooting guides.
decisions: Offline local inference and rule-based diagnostic models to ensure complete air-gap compliance
High-throughput streaming log parser handling multi-switch network telemetry simultaneously
Structured diagnostic playbooks mapped against common network routing, port, and security faults
case_study.outcome: Enabled zero-leakage, real-time network anomaly identification and cut mean time to remediation during mission-critical drills.

featured_projects.title: Beacon – Hackathon Prototype (Wildcard Track: CSR Project Lifecycle Management)
featured_projects.description: Beacon transforms scattered WhatsApp updates from CSR field partners into structured, audit-ready, compliance-linked project records.
features: Ingests unstructured field updates (text, photos, and voice notes) sent by CSR partners over WhatsApp
Parsing and validation layer structuring raw inputs into compliance-linked project milestone entries
Tamper-evident audit chain recording every update, timestamp, and modification for strict verification
Directly supports the generation of statutory CSR-2 regulatory compliance reports from verified records

case_study.problem: Corporate social responsibility projects rely on scattered, unverified field WhatsApp messages that fail compliance audits and make statutory reporting painful.
case_study.built: Architected Beacon, a data ingestion and verification pipeline converting multi-format field updates into immutable, audit-ready CSR-2 documentation.
decisions: Addressed data quality at the source by enabling field partners to report naturally via WhatsApp text, photos, and audio
Implemented a structured parsing layer to normalize milestone deliverables against approved grant line items
Engineered a tamper-evident audit log guaranteeing non-repudiation for statutory compliance audits
case_study.outcome: Transformed fragmented field communications into clean, audit-ready datasets, enabling automated generation of statutory CSR-2 filings.
